guard: the ephemeral teardown credential can delete endpoint-plane streams while every standing profile remains denied
why: deleteSpace can name a stream and still fail under auth mode if its sole teardown credential
does not carry the matching INFO and DELETE subjects. The runtime auth smoke asks the broker
about EPR directly, so removing the endpoint list from the credential must fail that named cell.

mutations.name: endpoint-plane delete grants are omitted from the teardown credential
mutations.expectRed: STREAM.DELETE an endpoint record-ingress stream ALLOWED
mutations.cell: STREAM.DELETE an endpoint record-ingress stream ALLOWED
